note:
651 -> 649: odoo/orm/registration.py, -13, plus +11 that cannot be attributed. Re-derived at 2bdc12dbed8; the previous floor's own base commit no longer exists.

THE MOVE IS NOT ONE NUMBER. Measured per section 9.3 at 2bdc12dbed8 with mypy==2.3.0 alone in a fresh venv, detached worktree, --no-incremental:

    662  HEAD, nothing applied
    649  HEAD with this change

  651 (old floor) + 11 (drift, see below) - 13 (this change) = 649.

REGISTRY NARROWING, -13. The previous note said: "MetaModel.pool is Registry | None and that is CORRECT and load-bearing: a model DEFINITION class has no pool, and that is precisely how registration tells a definition class from a registry class. The 11 sites reading model_cls.pool want narrowing asserts in registry bootstrap, which deserves its own change." This is that change; the tree had grown to 13 sites across 8 functions.

The narrowing is one helper, `registration.registry_of(model_cls) -> Registry`, placed directly beneath `is_model_definition()` because the two are the same invariant read in opposite directions: that function asks whether the pool is absent, this one asserts it is present. Every function in the module runs on registry classes, so the assert belongs once at a named boundary rather than 13 times at the reads -- or, as now, nowhere, with each read silently assuming what no one had written down.

`pool` keeps its `Registry | None` annotation. It is not the annotation that was wrong.

THE +11 CANNOT BE ATTRIBUTED, and the reason is worth recording rather than absorbing quietly. The old floor's note ends "measured ... in a detached worktree at ea183558595". That commit is not in the repository -- `git cat-file -t` answers `Not a valid object name`. The branch was rebased away from it, the same hazard section 4 documents for its own pinned figures. So the gap between 651 and the 662 measured here may be drift added without banking, or the rebase may have moved the tree the floor described, and nothing on disk can now separate the two. What IS established is that none of it comes from the ORM audit this change belongs to: with that audit's commits reverted the error SET is character-identical, diffed as a set rather than compared as a count.

The new floor is derived at a commit that exists, so the next person can reproduce it.

WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE. The other three clusters the previous note listed as intentional are untouched and its reasoning still holds: iteration.py's comparison dunders duck-type inside try/except AttributeError on purpose, decorators.py stamps marker attributes the type system cannot express, and the two _RequestUIDLike diagnostics are the only place the runtime contract is visibly wider than the annotation. The 18 `Registry | None` diagnostics outside registration.py -- 4 in model_test_env.py, 1 in fields/base.py -- are a different shape: those read a pool off a model INSTANCE rather than a class, and narrowing them wants its own look.

MYPY DELTAS DO NOT COMPOSE, as the previous note warns. This one was union-measured, not subtracted: the -13 is the set difference between two full runs at the same commit, and nothing was introduced.
